title: Failed pickup at seller
summary: Agent arrived but the seller is closed, the item isn't ready, or it's under-declared.

opts.label: Item not ready / can't be found

end: Agent calls the seller and CS; keeps call log and photo.
Cancel with reason 'Arrived but seller closed', proof attached as POD.
50% cancellation fee applies — customer acknowledges first.
Agent calls the seller and CS.
TikTok: allow 10 mins for packing; over 15 mins waiting counts as failed pickup.
Cancel with reason 'Parcel not ready' with photo and call log; 50% fee applies after customer acknowledges.
Agent contacts CS and takes a photo of the item.
Cancel with reason 'Parcel under-declared'. TikTok: raise over/under-declared to TikTok at once.
